artifacts.summary: Research report: identifies the two jq `//`-operator sites in sapience.nix's sapienceBootstrap script that silently reset config.json's "hooks": false opt-out to true, confirms from direct vendor-source reading that the opt-out gates only wire_hooks()/cli_auto_on_plan() and never the per-repository mcp.py/sapience_cli.py hook invocations, recommends a default-not-force null-test fix at both sites, scopes a new home-manager activation guard check (new code in modules/, not an edit to the extension's own verify-sapience-mcp.sh which is the companion task's territory), and scopes the docs/sapience.md update.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 142 --plan to create an implementation plan from this research.
